description: This PHP source file defines the class pCache, which implements caching functionality for chart images. It provides methods for creating, flushing, storing, retrieving, and managing cached chart images to improve rendering performance.
external_files: files accessed via file_exists, touch, unlink, fopen, fread, fwrite, fclose, rename

classes.name: pCache
classes.description: A class for caching chart images to speed up rendering by storing generated images and associated index and database files. Provides methods to manage, retrieve, and delete cache entries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes cache folder and database files, creating them if they do not exist.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Clears the cache by resetting the index and database files.

methods.name: getHash
methods.description: Generates an MD5 hash key for the given data array and optional marker to identify cached charts.

methods.name: writeToCache
methods.description: Saves a chart image to the cache, storing its raw PNG data and updating index and database files.

methods.name: removeOlderThan
methods.description: Removes cached items older than the specified timestamp.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific cache entry by its ID.

methods.name: dbRemoval
methods.description: Removes cache entries matching certain criteria such as name or age.

methods.name: isInCache
methods.description: Checks if a cache entry with the specified ID exists, optionally updating hit count or returning detailed info.

methods.name: autoOutput
methods.description: Outputs cached image directly; adapts for CLI or web environment.

methods.name: strokeFromCache
methods.description: Outputs the raw cached image directly to browser output.

methods.name: saveFromCache
methods.description: Saves the cached image to a specified file.

methods.name: getFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves the raw image data from cache for a given ID.
